summary: # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial: Setting Up Chinese Fabric Presets ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to set up Chinese fabric presets in Marvelous Designer. This process involves importing fabric files with Chinese names and configuring the software to recognize them. ## Default Physics Attributes In the current version of Marvelous Designer, the default physics attribute corresponds to the name of the English version of the fabric. The name reflects the kind of fabric, and the physics attribute is measured accordingly. ## Importing Fabric Files 1. **Access the Fabric Folder** Navigate to the Fabric folder in the drawing window, where the fabrics are also named in English. 2. **Preview Fabric on the Shrink Chart** When the mouse hovers over the shrink chart, you can see a preview of the fabric placed on the ball. 3. **Add New Fabric** Click the **Add button**, select the downloaded and compressed Fabric folder, and import the default fabric file that has a Chinese name. 4. **Verify Name Change** After importing, the mouse should be positioned over the shrink chart of the fabric, allowing you to confirm that the name has changed to a Chinese name. ## Replacing the Default File Next, you will need to replace the default file in the system with the translated file. 1. **Access Settings Menu** Click on the default file in the settings menu located in the main menu. 2. **Set Default Fabric Folder** Configure the default fabric folder to point to the path of the translated Fabric folder. 3. **Restart Marvelous Designer** After making the changes, it is necessary to restart Marvelous Designer for the updates to take effect. ## Previewing Physics Attributes Once Marvelous Designer has restarted, open the preview of the physics attribute. You should see that the name has been successfully changed to Chinese. ## Using the Fabric Folder 1. **Access the Fabric Folder** Open the Fabric folder to view the Chinese names and purposes of each type of fabric. 2. **Selection Based on Needs** You can choose fabrics based on your specific requirements. 3. **Utilizing the Default Asset Manager** Alternatively, you can use the default Asset Manager. To do this: - Go to the Asset Manager. - Select the default Asset Manager. - Click the **Temporary Login icon**. 4. **Naming the Type of Parse** You can assign a name to the type of parse. 5. **Setting Default Mask** Click the Asset Manager icon and set the default mask to 0. ## Final Adjustments On the final page, you will see the value of the number of lines you want to color in the source of the code set to 0. Click **Founder** to finalize your settings. ## Conclusion By following these steps, you will successfully set up Chinese fabric presets in Marvelous Designer. The results will remain consistent across all sources of value for the fabric parameters.
